review.scope: DOT has read PR392 actual source and original ZIP, accepts the existing20 contracts, two revised current-use cases, three UI cases, composed PG phases and the two additional original P/R scope cases. This does not approve the new CI control code.
limitations: Original failed invocations remain failed. Selected passed rows are not a claim of whole failing invocation success.
WIP source hashes were recorded but not all pre-edit WIP bytes archived. Current roots bind current consumers, not reconstructed historical environments.

Current input differs only in the reviewed private P/R rejection, a UI reason/type and the CI-only probe entry. Happy paths without original P/R are unchanged; private scope is covered by the new two cases.
The sole real browser consumer is NOTRUN locally due to sandbox ownership; it must pass on the same current build in Actions. No Profile/model/FINAL matrix is reexecuted.
